output_type: PHOTOREALISTIC PRODUCT PHOTOGRAPH of a real physical object — NOT a flat graphic, NOT an illustration, NOT a 3D CG render look. This must look like an actual photograph of a manufactured wooden box, matching references/supplier-box-wuhan-front.jpg's own photographic quality exactly.

lid_graphic_content._source: Element-count parity with the Wuhan reference, per the owner's explicit direction: wuhan-design-analysis.json has 1 dominant + 6 secondary + 1 filler + 1 delight + 1 nameplate = 10 distinct elements. This spec matches that count with real, verified La Salle equivalents (nameplate/text still excluded per the standing logo decision, so a 10th visual element replaces it rather than leaving the count short).

element_1_dominant_landmark._source: school-building-analysis.json — extracted directly from the real building photo, not a paraphrase
element_1_dominant_landmark.overall_form: Single multi-story building, prominent continuously curved convex facade on the upper section (curving outward toward viewer), transitioning to a flatter lower section
element_1_dominant_landmark.facade_banding: Wide, light-colored, evenly-spaced horizontal balcony bands projecting from the curve, strong horizontal emphasis
element_1_dominant_landmark.window_pattern: Continuous horizontal ribbon windows set back behind the balcony bands on the upper curved floors, with visible vertical mullions; large multi-pane rectangular windows on the first floor above ground
element_1_dominant_landmark.roofline: Flat roofline defined by the topmost projecting balcony band, slight overhang
element_1_dominant_landmark.materials: Light grey concrete/stucco facade and balcony bands, dark grey/black window mullions, reflective glass

element_2_secondary.element: Entrance canopy / covered walkway at street level
element_2_secondary._source: school-building-analysis.json's ground_floor_treatment — wide, slightly curved overhang above the entrance, multiple glass door panels. NO signage or text on it.

element_3_secondary.element: A sports court with fence line
element_3_secondary._source: visible in references/school-students-jumping.jpg's background — a real campus feature, plays the same role as Wuhan's secondary buildings

element_4_secondary.element: A colorful abstract mosaic mural on a nearby school building wall
element_4_secondary._source: references/school-building-mural.jpg — a real, distinct visual feature of the campus (blue/multicolor abstract art on a large building facade), adds the same kind of visual variety Wuhan gets from mixing pagoda + modern building + European-style building

lid_graphic_content.element_5_secondary_context: Distant Kowloon residential apartment towers in the background sky, grounding the scene in a real Hong Kong location — same role as Wuhan's own distant background buildings

element_6_secondary_catholic_motif._source: catholic-motifs-analysis.json — abstracted from the school's real stained-glass and mosaic, WITHOUT any human figures
element_6_secondary_catholic_motif.element: A simple bold Latin cross silhouette with concentric radiating arced bands behind it (gold, red/orange, blue), echoing the mosaic's radiating-arch pattern
element_6_secondary_catholic_motif.rendering: Flat, solid color fills, crisp clean lines, no gradients, no shading, no human figures of any kind
element_6_secondary_catholic_motif.placement: Positioned in the upper sky area, sized comparably to Wuhan's hot-air-balloon accent — visible and legible, not tiny, but not the dominant element either

lid_graphic_content.element_7_secondary_heraldic: A laurel branch (left edge, vertical) — from the crest's heraldic framing
lid_graphic_content.element_8_secondary_heraldic: A holly branch (right edge, vertical) — the crest's OTHER heraldic side ornament, paired with the laurel the way the crest itself balances them left/right
lid_graphic_content.element_9_secondary_natural: Street trees along the building's base, matching what's actually visible in references/school-building-streetview.jpg

element_10_delight.element: The school's real indoor competitive swimming pool: red-and-navy striped lane ropes across the water, a small winner's podium with a trophy
element_10_delight.why: The one large, singular, TRUE local detail — this school's actual real championship pool — matching how Wuhan's ferris wheel or Chongqing's hotpot bowl is one true specific detail, not a generic symbol

lid_graphic_content.human_figures: NONE ANYWHERE — hard rule, confirmed across every supplier reference design
lid_graphic_content.text_or_logo: NONE ANYWHERE — reserved for separate compositing, not part of this render
lid_graphic_content.density_target: 90 percent of the lid area filled with layered detail, matching the supplier references' own density — with 10 elements plus filler greenery this should be achievable naturally, not by padding
lid_graphic_content.composition_style: Match references/supplier-box-wuhan-front.jpg and references/supplier-box-nanjing-3stack.jpg exactly: flat-vector illustration technique (medium-thin dark brown outlines, flat color fills, minimal cel-shading, stylized 3/4 isometric perspective) printed onto the lid — the ILLUSTRATION STYLE is flat-vector even though the OVERALL PHOTO of the box is photorealistic. Think: a real photo of a real box whose lid happens to have a flat-vector graphic UV-printed on it, same as every supplier reference photo actually is.

physical_construction._source: box-construction-analysis.json — extracted directly from the real supplier product photos, with two factual corrections applied (dimensions, knob position) after verifying against the spec sheet
physical_construction.edge_technique: Laser-cut finger joints with uniformly dark brown/charred edges from the laser cutting process — matte, slightly rough, fibrous texture, sharply contrasting with the smooth painted surfaces. This charred edge texture is critical to get right.
physical_construction.body_color_and_finish: Uniform light pastel sky-blue paint, smooth matte-to-satin finish, no visible wood grain on painted surfaces
physical_construction.lid_construction: The lid graphic panel sits recessed slightly within a frame formed by the box's side-wall top edges; the frame shows the same charred laser-cut edge texture; rounded corners matching the box profile
physical_construction.hardware: A single oval brushed-silver metal wind-up knob on a SIDE WALL (not the bottom), roughly centered vertically, with a fine knurled grid pattern on its face and a visible Phillips-head screw, approximately 2.5-3cm long, protruding about 1cm

photography.camera_angle: Slightly elevated eye-level shot, looking directly at the front/top face of the box with a subtle downward angle, box centered in frame
photography.lighting: Soft, diffused lighting from front-top-left, bright and even, minimal harsh reflections
photography.shadow: Very soft, subtle, short shadow directly beneath the box
photography.depth_of_field: Deep — entire product in sharp focus front to back
photography.color_grading: Bright, clean, neutral, accurate color reproduction, fresh and product-focused

hard_exclusions: no people, children, or human figures anywhere, including within the Catholic motif
no logo, crest, shield, badge, plaque, or nameplate shape
no large empty/blank lid areas — the lid graphic must be dense (90%) like the reference boxes
do not render this as a flat 2D illustration overall — the OVERALL image must be a photorealistic product photograph; only the lid's own printed graphic is flat-vector in style
